shots.narration: Japan's commercial trucks drive with sixty percent of their capacity unused.
shots.read: Japan's commercial trucks... drive with sixty percent of their capacity... unused.

shots.narration: Japan is running short of truck drivers. Government estimates say that by 2030, trucking capacity could fall short by up to a quarter.
shots.read: Japan is running short of truck drivers. Government estimates say that by twenty thirty... trucking capacity could fall short by up to a quarter.

shots.narration: There aren't enough drivers, yet sixty percent of what trucks can carry goes unused. The ones who struggle most are small carriers and small shippers.
shots.read: There aren't enough drivers... yet sixty percent of what trucks can carry goes unused. The ones who struggle most are small carriers, and small shippers.

shots.narration: One reason trucks run empty is the miles they drive with no load. Backfull layers national statistics, counts of large trucks on national highways, and more, to map where trucks come home empty. Freight from Tokyo to Kagoshima is about one sixth of the flow the other way. Just seeing it helps you decide where to look for loads.

shots.narration: What if that empty space on the way home could carry a small shipper's goods? Backfull connects the two.
shots.read: What if... that empty space on the way home could carry a small shipper's goods? Backfull connects the two.

shots.narration: At my company, I oversee logistics cost, speed, quality, and delivery efficiency. Drawing on that experience, I used Japan's open data to build a tool that makes everyday problems visible. Backfull does four things. See where trucks come home empty. Match empty space with cargo. Draft a request about waiting time. Compare ways to ship.

shots.narration: Satsuma Transport hauls vegetables in Kagoshima with eight trucks. Its trucks come home empty. Its drivers lose hours waiting to load. And it's hard to raise that with the shipper.
shots.read: Satsuma Transport hauls vegetables in Kagoshima, with eight trucks. Its trucks come home empty. Its drivers lose hours waiting to load. And... it's hard to raise that with the shipper.

shots.narration: With Backfull, just load your dispatch schedule to see which days and which routes come home empty. Drivers log the waiting time themselves. On a smartphone, they just tap when they arrive and when they leave. From those records and the history so far, Claude's Opus, Sonnet, and Haiku split the work to draft a clear request to the shipper.
shots.read: With Backfull, just load your dispatch schedule to see which days, and which routes, come home empty. Drivers log the waiting time themselves. On a smartphone, they just tap when they arrive, and when they leave. From those records and the history so far, Claude's Opus, Sonnet, and Haiku split the work to draft a clear request to the shipper.

shots.narration: Two artisans who opened an Edo kiriko glass studio in Tokyo want to ship glassware and display shelves to a shochu distillery's event in Kagoshima. Enter the details in Backfull, and you get the options that work, why others don't, an estimated price, and even a quote request. Chartering a whole truck came to about 270,000 yen.

shots.narration: Search Backfull for return trips, and Satsuma Transport's empty truck heading home costs 95,000 yen. That's about 178,000 yen less than chartering.
shots.read: Search Backfull for return trips, and Satsuma Transport's empty truck heading home costs ninety-five thousand yen. That's about one hundred seventy-eight thousand yen less than chartering.

shots.narration: I built this tool solo in one week with Claude Code. Using subagents, skills, MCP, and hooks, I refined it through round after round of scoring and fixes.

shots.narration: Load your weekly dispatch schedule, and the road home empty becomes a road that delivers someone's cargo. Turn trucks that haul air into trucks that haul freight. Backfull.
